items.title: +39 to-action threads not itemized (calls, attachments, info drops)
items.summary: 11 missed calls/voicemails landed in the window (mostly unnamed numbers; five completed calls had no recording) and need a call back; the rest are older call-backs, attachments to check (often payment proofs) and address drops. FYI threads (59, none new in 24h), 37 would-clear closers/spam, and 196 backlog threads older than 14 days are counted in triage only.

needs_attention: Open call commitments (by us): Basil's matching 8-ft baseboard (promised same day 10-10; confirm it arrived); unnamed vinyl caller (~1,400 sf, order for Tuesday 10-13 pickup, he will text); Mary's install start date (Oct 15 vs 16 still open). Albert is away a few days, so Pourya and Front Desk are covering.

Wins today: 3 project deals, $45,138.45 total (Mike $9,379.00, Dante $20,559.45, Nash $15,200.00) - need install scheduling/deposit check; Nash also has a 40h-unanswered email about the revised quote and tax.
GHL waiting 24h+: 8 - oldest Albert G. (39d), Sabrina A. (29d), Mohammad S. (11d)
GHL to action 24h+: 33 - oldest DUNRTIC C. (199d), TOLL C. (178d), (647) 6. (90d) (mostly missed-call call-backs and attachments to check)
GHL opt-out: set DND for 2 - Franca P., Eden P.
GHL backlog: 196 unread reply/action threads are older than 14 days (counted, not itemized)
Triage pilot: 37 would clear (35 closers, 2 spam) - list at the end of the brief

Workflow drift: meeting_no_followup 4 (Abid H., Anna M., Siham M., Chris P.); followup_not_fired 2 (Keith Hinkson, Nora Hamid); categorization_miss 1 (Naman Shah); stale_approaching 51 (incl. 37 already past threshold with no stale_lead tag - automation may not be firing)
Naman Shah: in-home visit Oct 15 15:00; he sent photos by SMS and has no lead tag yet.
Calls: 5 inbound completed calls (unnamed numbers) have no recording or transcript - check whether they were real conversations.

calls.summary: Caller (Fernando, the drywall customer) phoned at opening to ask whether the store was open; told yes.
Automated lead-whisper line: announces a new web lead (floor and stairs, up to 500 sf vinyl) and asks to press a key; nobody connected and it disconnected.
Staff called Fernando back about 70 sheets of drywall for a Queensway/Dixie address; he asked for a price and said Titan is cheaper than Home Depot. We said we would find the price and text or call.
Follow-up call giving Fernando the drywall price: $15 per sheet plus $300 delivery. He said he would let us know.

Naman Shah, who visited the showroom last Saturday, called because nobody had followed up on hardwood for the main floor and 12 stairs in a Milton townhouse. Staff took details and said they would arrange a visit Wed or Thu next week; it was booked that evening for Oct 15.

commitments.what: book in-home visit Wed/Thu next week

calls.summary: Voicemail of about one second; only ringing audio, nothing said.
Caller asked about stock of 12x24 Antarctica Ice polished tile; staff confirmed it is in stock.

Basil (finished job) called Pourya: a few places lack finishing baseboard and his contractor needs an 8-ft standard piece today. Pourya said he had leftovers and would bring it himself or send someone.

commitments.what: deliver 8-ft baseboard to match, same day
